quartet_policy: Quartet b1 reuses canonical Blue Reflection records; RAY is Quartet b2; SUN is Quartet b3; Second Light uses its standalone JP/EN as canonical content and Quartet b4 as en_auxiliary and target data.
owns: translation notes and per-record review status
second_light_auxiliary_policy: Quartet b4 auxiliary references are stored only when they contain usable English. Empty, redacted, invalid-copy and unavailable source values remain null and are classified precisely in alignment.auxiliary_value_status. Quartet-only extension records do not use en_auxiliary.
